title: Linkmery:  Library of Links
exampleSearches: that site with pricing page examples
why: Good links get lost in chats, notes and saved posts.
So I gave mine a home: the {count} I actually reach for, each with a note on when it helps.
I made it for myself, to keep for years.
It's open so I can hand a shelf to the people I care about.
nameOrigin: The name blends almari, the cupboard where Indian homes keep what matters, with library and "link meri": my links.
description: Links that are needed at the right time, should be at the right place, now it's a library.
